sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 14 July 2025, pitch SYN-SYNCP000033-P1 was put before Riverbend Physician Alliance 033 on behalf of GSK PHARM.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 2 rebate of 3.5 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Tdap minimum take of 1,330 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer came back with a counter.
